facts.fact: Bethany 告诉 Starlight 前台的职员：房间里有一个 man made of static。
facts.anchor: “Yeah,” Bethany told the guy at reception at the Starlight. “A man made of static.”

facts.fact: Bethany 请前台陪她回房取回笔记本电脑和全部行李，说不敢单独进去。
facts.anchor: “Look. My laptop and all my stuff is still back in the room. Will you come with me to get it? I don’t feel safe going in there alone.”

facts.fact: 在 bus depot，Bethany 意识到自己无意中偷走了 Jules Estrada 的手枪——她在 Jules 从 Taco Bell 回来前把枪放进了包，随后在混乱中把这事忘得一干二净。
facts.anchor: Later, at the bus depot, Bethany realized she’d accidentally stolen Jules Estrada’s handgun. She’d put it in her bag before Jules returned from Taco Bell, and then had forgotten all about it in the clamor that followed.

facts.fact: Bethany 拿出手机再次打给妈妈，电话响了四次；就在她以为要转语音信箱时，妈妈接了电话。
facts.anchor: She took out her cellphone and called her mom again. It rang four times, and just when Bethany assumed it would go to voicemail, her mother picked up.

facts.fact: Bethany 对妈妈说：她真的需要回家。
facts.anchor: “I just…I think I really need to come back home.”

facts.fact: 妈妈拒绝了：现在不是好时候——Daddy 的健康问题，加上房子的装修工程。
facts.anchor: “Honey, I’m sorry. It’s not a very good time. Daddy’s health issues, and the renovations with the house…”

facts.fact: 妈妈提议 Bethany 和 Abel 圣诞节回来拜访，几个月后再联系。
facts.anchor: “Maybe you and Abel can visit for Christmas,” her mom said. “Let’s check in about it in a few months?”

facts.fact: Bethany 挂断电话，在 bus depot 里又坐了一会儿，手里攥着 tote bag 里的 Jules 的手枪；窗外太阳渐渐升起。
facts.anchor: Bethany hung up the phone. She sat a while longer in the bus depot clutching Jules’s handgun inside her tote bag. Eventually the sun began to rise out the window.
